review.notes: All 26 physical pages compared against the extracted PDF text (5-gram word-coverage scan) with heading and code-fence structure checks (no fences; heading hierarchy matches the printed sections). Diffs concentrated in OCR line-wrap hyphenation and LaTeX-equivalent math, which are not defects. Eight confirmed Markdown-escape defects (\_ where the PDF prints real underscores) were each verified on 300-600 dpi renders of physical pages 1, 9, 15 and 21.
